sections.text:
-Target: 1 random enemy out of all enemies. Ability Power 100. Success value 70. 10x physical damage (Time).
Ability Power boosted by 5 for each increase in Skill level.
-Target: yourself. Increases ATK by 20% for 60 seconds.
-Target: yourself. Increases MATK by 20% for 60 seconds.
[Unison Effect Boost] Increases the Ability Power of the 100-Ability-Power attack that deals time-elemental physical damage 10 times to 1 random enemy at success of 70 points by 50.
[Unison Effect Boost] Increases the Ability Power of the 100-Ability-Power attack that deals time-elemental physical damage 10 times to 1 random enemy at success of 70 points by 50.
[Additional Unison Effect] Increases the ATK and MATK of all allies excluding your character by 20% for 60 seconds.
